v1.0.0.changelog: Initial prototype with local Gerber upload parser.

v2.0.0.changelog: Full production e-commerce release with Razorpay integration and automated PCB dimension verification.

spec.overview: A production-grade e-commerce platform providing PCB prototyping, 3D printing, and laser-cutting services, featuring automated design file verification.
spec.architecture: Features a single-page React frontend with custom TypeScript modules, a Node.js REST API using Prisma ORM, and local VPS hosting running automatic git deployments.

subsystems.name: Frontend Interface
subsystems.function: Dynamic viewport parser and user dashboard.

subsystems.name: Backend REST API
subsystems.function: Handles order validation, user profiles, and vendor communications.

subsystems.name: Authentication Layer
subsystems.function: Secures dashboard access and API tokens.

subsystems.name: Payment Gateway
subsystems.function: Processes payments through Razorpay webhooks securely.

subsystems.name: Deployment Stack
subsystems.function: CI/CD server pipeline running git actions.

spec.challenges: Parsing raw Gerber vectors on server introduction RAM spikes.
spec.engineeringDecisions: Offloaded computation to client browser canvas, parsing vector profiles in local JavaScript.
spec.lessonsLearned: Database transactional locks prevent parallel Razorpay double payments.
spec.futureImprovements: Port to Rust WebAssembly module to accelerate heavy multi-layered drawing.

interviewQuestions.q: How did you guarantee 0.1mm accuracy in the Gerber parser?
interviewQuestions.a: Parser extracts coordinates scale headers directly from RS-274X files and converts layout grids into absolute pixel drawing offsets.

replay.title: Gerber Math & SVG Engine
replay.description: Constructed client-side parser validating circuit board profiles from coordinates.
replay.decisions: Rendered SVG nodes directly in React to retain responsive UI zooming and pan capabilities.
replay.challenges: Handling custom aperture macros defined inside files.
replay.lessons: Apertures must be cached in memory key-value stores before coordinates tracing starts.

replay.title: Order State FSM & Transaction Lock
replay.description: Designed transaction lock guards preventing concurrent order updates during Razorpay handshakes.
replay.decisions: Used MySQL transaction levels (Serializable) to verify state updates.
replay.lessons: Locking order rows by index instead of full tables avoids deadlock situations.

replay.title: Continuous Deployment Stack
replay.description: Automated pipeline compiling production assets on VPS on git push triggers.
replay.decisions: Built lightweight bash actions instead of heavy Docker clusters to suit limited VPS resources.
replay.challenges: Server timeouts during webpack asset packaging.
replay.lessons: Pre-building files in staging and copying artifacts prevents production downtime.
